draft.internal_note: Customer asks if Ridgeline Pour-Over Kettle works on induction. Catalog states it is NOT compatible with induction cooktops. Provide that answer.
draft.reply:
Hi Noah,

Thanks for reaching out! The Ridgeline Pour-Over Kettle is not compatible with induction cooktops. It works on gas burners, electric coil stoves, and camp stoves.

Let us know if you have any other questions.
